_doc: A tree's research record: every value read from a cited source (pipeline/tree_cards.py writes the trait card from it). `src` on a value is the index (0-based) into `sources`. Write null where no source gives a value; never guess. Free-text fields are short and factual.
common: an English common name if one is in use, else the most used local name
aliases: other common names, lower case, underscores for spaces
habit: one of: broadleaf_tree | palm_solitary | palm_clustered | strangler | other (describe in notes)

crown.shape: e.g. umbrella | hemispherical | narrow | open irregular | shuttlecock (palm)

leaf.type: simple | pinnate | bipinnate | palmate_compound | trifoliate | pinnate_palm_frond | palmate_palm_frond
leaf.shape: elliptic | oblong | lanceolate | obovate | ovate | cordate

bark.texture: smooth | lenticellate | flaking | fissured | furrowed | ringed (palm)

eaten_by.animal: Genus species (scientific, as eaten in the source)

notes: anything the card writer should know: what the sources disagree on, what was not found

sources.licence: as stated by the site (e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0 for Wikipedia)
